name: John Lamoreaux
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives John a birth date of 21 Nov 1780 at Monroe and a death date of 13 Aug 1853 in Jackson Twp, but a burial in 1852; the site has his death in 1852. It cites a Historical Society of Pennsylvania death card and his father's probate file (S1). FamilySearch names Martha Ives as his wife, but she was Joshua's wife (see H0181), so that looks like a cross-attachment.

sources.citation: FamilySearch published tree, John Lamoreaux (KP7J-XC7), with attached index entries

researchLogEntry: Round 4: FamilySearch gives b. 21 Nov 1780; death 1853 vs 1852 burial conflict; wife Martha Ives misattached.
